Nina is reading a book about English. There are always many people at the old town. They took many photos at the old town. Best of all, different people react to spicy food in different ways.
The airport is one of the best places in the city. The weather was cloudy that day. Ben is interested in swimming. For example, we watched the sunset over the sea at Ayr.
Life is full of small surprises. Nina wrote about the day in the diary. Both of them like salad and coffee. Don't forget to bring your camera.
Nina plays table tennis with Ben every Friday. Nina spent the weekend at the park. It takes twenty minutes to get to the airport by bike.
